mapper.select: SELECT d.*, c.provider_id AS provider_id FROM provider_drama d LEFT JOIN short_drama_connection c ON c.id = d.connection_id WHERE d.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM provider_drama WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND external_drama_id = #{externalDramaId}
SELECT * FROM provider_drama ORDER BY remote_created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_drama (connection_id,external_drama_id,title,original_title,title_zh,description,cover_url,label_names,category_name,language,remote_rank,drama_type,novel_type,novel_sub_type,remote_show_status,local_status,remote_created_at,remote_updated_at,last_seen_at) VALUES (#{connectionId},#{externalDramaId},#{title},#{originalTitle},#{titleZh},#{description},#{coverUrl},#{labelNames},#{categoryName},#{language},#{remoteRank},#{dramaType},#{novelType},#{novelSubType},#{remoteShowStatus},CASE WHEN #{remoteShowStatus} = '1' THEN 'PUBLISHED' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END,#{remoteCreatedAt},#{remoteUpdatedAt},#{lastSeenAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title=VALUES(title),original_title=VALUES(original_title),title_zh=VALUES(title_zh),description=VALUES(description),cover_url=VALUES(cover_url),label_names=VALUES(label_names),category_name=VALUES(category_name),language=VALUES(language),remote_rank=VALUES(remote_rank),drama_type=VALUES(drama_type),novel_type=VALUES(novel_type),novel_sub_type=VALUES(novel_sub_type),local_status=CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(remote_show_status),'') <> '1' AND local_status='PUBLISHED' THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE local_status END,remote_show_status=VALUES(remote_show_status),remote_created_at=VALUES(remote_created_at),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at),last_seen_at=VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_drama_content WHERE drama_id = #{dramaId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_drama_content (drama_id,external_content_id,sequence_no,title,is_free,duration_seconds,content_url,remote_updated_at) VALUES (#{dramaId},#{externalContentId},#{sequenceNo},#{title},#{free},#{durationSeconds},#{contentUrl},#{remoteUpdatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE external_content_id=VALUES(external_content_id),title=VALUES(title),is_free=VALUES(is_free),duration_seconds=VALUES(duration_seconds),content_url=VALUES(content_url),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM provider_drama d JOIN short_drama_connection c ON c.id = d.connection_id WHERE c.provider_id = #{providerId} AND d.remote_show_status = '1' AND (#{language} IS NULL OR d.language = #{language}) AND d.id > #{afterId} AND (#{missingOnly} = FALSE OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider_drama_content dc WHERE dc.drama_id = d.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider_drama_content dc WHERE dc.drama_id = d.id AND (dc.content_url IS NULL OR dc.content_url = '') )) ORDER BY d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_drama WHERE local_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND remote_show_status = '1' AND language = #{language}

SELECT d.*, c.provider_id, p.provider_name FROM provider_drama d JOIN short_drama_connection c ON c.id = d.connection_id JOIN short_drama_provider p ON p.id = c.provider_id WHERE d.local_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.remote_show_status = '1' AND d.language = #{language} ORDER BY d.remote_created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
